title: Session picker
description: Agents window picker button (`.sessions-chat-picker-slot`): icon + label (+ chevron) that opens the picker's real options in an action list. Kinds: `environment` (This Computer, Cloud, remote environments), `workspace` (recent folders, Chat, Open Folder…), `isolation` (Branch, New Worktree), `branch`, `harness` (Copilot, Claude, Codex), and the composer's `claude-approvals`, `codex-modes` and `codex-approvals`. Header kinds (environment, workspace, harness) sit in their own one-item toolbar; the workspace picker has a clear (×) button. Options come from ds.chatPickers, captured from the signed-in product. Choosing an option updates the button and fires `change`.
usage: Usually rendered for you by <vsc-session-options> and <vsc-chat-input variant="session|new-session">. Set `kind` and `value` (an option id from ds.chatPickers.data); `label`/`icon` override the option's.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected option id, e.g. local, cloud, vscode, worktree, claude

states.name: open
states.description: aria-expanded=true while its list is open

states.name: compact
states.description: its icon only (compact-picker). Set by the composer's responsive pass; CSS from source (not captured).
states.trigger: the composer runs out of room
